text_markup: If an interface ability specifies that it affects a particular subtype of ice, then that ability can only be used on a piece of ice that has the specified subtype. If an ability on an {subtype:icebreaker} does not specify a subtype of ice that it affects, that ability can be used on any piece of ice.
text_plain: If an interface ability specifies that it affects a particular subtype of ice, then that ability can only be used on a piece of ice that has the specified subtype.
